subject: 综合英语（一）
intro: 按综合英语（一）期末卷的五大部分拆考点：听力、阅读（含选词填空）、词汇与结构、翻译、写作。教材以外语教学与研究出版社《新视野大学英语读写教程 1》为参照，题目自编、标注来源。

sections.name: 听力理解
sections.note: 短对话/长对话/短文，另含听写填空

sources.title: 2025 级《综合英语 1》期末考试 A 卷（公开卷面）
sources.note: 听力 30 / 阅读 30 / 词汇 10 / 翻译 15 / 写作 15

sources.title: 《新视野大学英语读写教程 1》Unit 1–8 + 综合英语课文讲义
sources.note: 考点与例句参照教材单元主题

chapters.title: 听力理解
chapters.summary: 30 分，靠场景词与同义替换，不靠逐词听懂。

chapters.title: 阅读理解与选词填空
chapters.summary: 40 分，先题干后原文，选词填空先判词性。

chapters.title: 词汇与结构
chapters.summary: 20 题 10 分，考搭配与时态语态，是最容易提分的部分。

chapters.title: 翻译（汉译英）
chapters.summary: 15 分整体评分，先搭主干再补修饰。

chapters.title: 写作
chapters.summary: 15 分，三段式 + 观点句 + 连接词，模板可复用。

points.title: 短对话：场景与关键词
points.core: 短对话不考全文理解，考「场景 + 关键信息」：听到 restaurant、menu、order 就是餐厅场景，问题多问「Where / What does the man mean」。
points.detail: 常见场景词：机场（boarding pass、delay、gate）、酒店（book a room、check out）、银行（open an account、withdraw）、医院（appointment、prescription）、图书馆（renew、due）。预读选项时先圈出场景词，再听关键词。
traps: 听到原词就选往往错，正确答案常用同义替换
转折词 but/however 后面才是答案

points.title: 数字、时间与计算
points.core: 数字题要边听边记，注意「半、差、倍、延迟」四类运算词：half past、a quarter to、twice as much、put off。
points.detail: 常考：票价打折（30% off）、时间推迟（delay by 20 minutes）、倍数（three times as large as）。听到两个数字时先判断哪个是干扰项。
traps: 「a quarter to nine」是 8:45 不是 9:15
「30% off」是打七折

points.title: 同义替换与态度判断
points.core: 听力答案很少照抄原文，而是同义改写；态度题抓形容词与语气词（actually、to be honest、I'm afraid）。
points.detail: 常见替换：buy → purchase、cheap → inexpensive、difficult → challenging、refuse → turn down。否定转移（I don't think he is right = I think he is wrong）是高频陷阱。
traps: I couldn't agree more 是「完全同意」
否定词 + 比较级常表最高级含义

points.title: 听写填空
points.core: 听写三遍：第一遍抓大意与空位，第二遍逐空写，第三遍检查拼写与单复数、时态。
points.detail: 常丢分点：词尾 -s/-ed、连读（not at all → no-ta-tall）、数字与专有名词大小写。写不全时先保证词性正确。
traps: 听到 /ə/ 就写 a，可能是 of/and 的弱读
单复数与主谓一致要在第三遍核对

points.title: 主旨题
points.core: 主旨看首段、各段首句与末段；正确选项覆盖面最大、不出现文中细节。
points.detail: 常见问法：main idea / best title / mainly about。排除法：只覆盖一段的、过于具体的、包含文中未提信息的都错。
traps: 标题题要选「最贴切」而不是「最吸引人」
首段有转折时主旨常在转折后

points.title: 细节题与定位
points.core: 先读题干圈关键词，再回原文定位同义表达，答案通常在定位句及其前后一句内。
points.detail: 定位词优先级：专有名词 > 数字 > 实义动词 > 形容词。注意题干与原文的时态、否定是否一致，偷换否定是常见错项。
traps: 原文说 some，选项改成 all 就是错
因果倒置也是常见错项

points.title: 词义猜测与指代
points.core: 猜词看上下文：同位语、破折号、举例、因果与对比关系都能给出线索；it/this/they 指代往前找最近的名词。
points.detail: 信号词：that is、in other words（解释）、for example（举例）、unlike/by contrast（反义）。猜出的词义放回原句要通顺。
traps: 按背过的第一个词义硬套常错
指代可能指代整句而非单个名词

points.title: 推断与态度题
points.core: 推断必须有原文依据，只推一步；态度看形容词与副词的评价色彩（fortunately、regrettably、questionable）。
points.detail: 常见态度词：positive / negative / neutral / objective / critical / doubtful。学术文章作者态度多为客观（objective），评论类才带褒贬。
traps: 推断过度（原文没说的不要选）
把文中人物态度当成作者态度

points.title: 选词填空：先判词性
points.core: 15 词选 10 空：先给每个词标词性，再按空格前后判断需要名词/动词/形容词/副词，最后看搭配与单复数。
points.detail: 判断依据：冠词后填名词、be 动词后填形容词或过去分词、主语后缺谓语填动词、修饰动词用副词。一个词只能用一次。
traps: 同一词根的名词/动词形式同时出现时要看句子成分
情态动词后必须用动词原形

points.title: 长难句拆分
points.core: 先找主谓宾，再把从句、分词短语、插入语括起来，一层层剥。
points.detail: 信号：that/which/who 引导定语从句；when/if/because 引导状语从句；-ing/-ed 短语作定语或状语；两个逗号之间常是插入语，先跳过。
traps: 把定语从句的谓语当成主句谓语
插入语里的动词干扰判断

points.title: 动词短语与固定搭配
points.core: 动词 + 介词/副词构成短语动词，意义常与动词原形无关：turn down（拒绝）、put off（推迟）、come up with（想出）、look forward to（期待，to 是介词）。
points.detail: 高频：account for、result in/from、be subject to、take ... into account、make up for。及物性决定能否带宾语，也决定被动语态写法。
traps: look forward to doing 不是 to do
result in（导致）与 result from（由…引起）方向相反

points.title: 介词与冠词
points.core: 介词考固定搭配与抽象关系：in charge of、on behalf of、at the expense of、by means of；冠词考特指与泛指。
points.detail: 抽象名词泛指不用冠词（Knowledge is power）；独一无二用 the；a/an 看读音不看拼写（an hour、a university）。
traps: an honest man（h 不发音）
go to school（抽象）vs go to the school（具体地点）

points.title: 时态与语态
points.core: 判断时态看时间状语与上下文：for/since + 现在完成；by the time + 过去完成；this time tomorrow + 将来进行。
points.detail: 主将从现：时间和条件状语从句用一般现在时表将来（When he comes, I will tell him）。不及物动词无被动（happen、occur、belong to）。
traps: has been done 与 had been done 的时间基准不同
The book is worth reading 不能用被动

points.title: 非谓语动词
points.core: 不定式表目的/将来，动名词表习惯/抽象动作，现在分词表主动/进行，过去分词表被动/完成。
points.detail: 固定搭配：decide/refuse/offer + to do；enjoy/mind/avoid/suggest + doing；remember/forget/stop 后接 to do 与 doing 意义不同。作状语时，逻辑主语要与主句主语一致（悬垂修饰是常见错项）。
traps: remember doing 是「记得做过」，remember to do 是「记得去做」
Having finished his homework, the TV was turned on 是悬垂修饰，错

points.title: 定语从句
points.core: 关系代词 who/whom/whose/which/that 与关系副词 when/where/why 的选择，取决于先行词与从句中缺什么成分。
points.detail: 缺主语/宾语用关系代词；缺状语用关系副词。介词 + which/whom 的固定搭配（in which = where）。非限制性定语从句不用 that，逗号不能省。
traps: 先行词被 all/only/最高级修饰时常用 that
非限制性从句用 which 不用 that

points.title: 状语从句与虚拟语气
points.core: if 虚拟三时态：与现在相反用 did/were + would do；与过去相反用 had done + would have done；与将来相反用 were to do/should do + would do。
points.detail: 其他虚拟：wish 后接过去时/过去完成；It's time that + 过去时；suggest/insist/demand 后从句用 (should) do。
traps: if 从句里不能用 would
suggest 表「暗示」时不用虚拟

points.title: 主谓一致与倒装
points.core: 主谓一致看真正的主语：each/every/no + 单数；the number of + 复数名词作主语时谓语用单数（a number of 用复数）。
points.detail: 否定词（never、hardly、not only）置句首要部分倒装；only + 状语置首也倒装。so/neither 引导的倒装表示「也一样/也不」。
traps: Not only ... but also 连接主语时谓语跟最近的主语
Hardly had he arrived when ... 固定搭配

points.title: 易混词辨析
points.core: 形近/义近词靠搭配区分：affect（动词，影响）vs effect（名词，效果）；adapt（适应）vs adopt（采纳）；principal（主要的/校长）vs principle（原则）。
points.detail: 常考组：rise/raise/arise、lie/lay、economic/economical、considerable/considerate、sensible/sensitive。
traps: effect 也可作动词但只用于「实现」，考试基本考名词
raise 是及物，rise 是不及物

points.title: 汉译英：先搭主干
points.core: 先确定主语和谓语（中文常省略主语，英文必须补），再把定语、状语挂上去；中文一个小句英文可以合并成一个从句。
points.detail: 步骤：① 找主干 ② 定时态 ③ 补主语（we/it/there be）④ 处理修饰（介词短语、定语从句、分词）⑤ 检查单复数与冠词。
traps: 逐字对译导致中式英语
忘记第三人称单数

points.title: 无主句与「把/被」句
points.core: 中文无主句可补 we/people/it，或改被动；「把」字句常转成「动词 + 宾语 + 补语」，「被」字句直接转被动语态。
points.detail: 例：「据说这座桥建于明朝」→ It is said that the bridge was built in the Ming Dynasty. 「人们普遍认为」→ It is widely believed that ...。
traps: 被动语态漏 be 动词
It is said that 后接完整句子

points.title: 文化负载词与时政表达
points.core: 中国文化词用「音译/直译 + 简释」策略：春节 the Spring Festival、四合院 courtyard house、共同富裕 common prosperity。
points.detail: 时政固定译法要背：高质量发展 high-quality development、人类命运共同体 a community with a shared future for mankind、碳中和 carbon neutrality。
traps: 「一带一路」是 the Belt and Road Initiative，不是 One Belt One Road
「小康社会」是 a moderately prosperous society

points.title: 整体评分与检查清单
points.core: 翻译按整体评分：内容完整、语言流畅即可拿高分，个别小错不逐字扣。交卷前按清单自查：时态一致、主谓一致、冠词、拼写、大小写。
points.detail: 写不出精确词时用上位词替换（如「毛笔」不会写可写 a traditional Chinese writing brush），保证句子完整比逐词精准更重要。
traps: 留空不写一定 0 分，写句子至少拿部分分
时态前后不一致会被判语言不流畅

points.title: 三段式结构与字数分配
points.core: 120–150 词议论文：引言 2–3 句（背景 + 观点）、主体 4–6 句（两个理由 + 例证）、结论 2 句（重申 + 建议）。
points.detail: 段落之间空行，每段一个中心。字数不足会扣分，超太多也不加分；宁可在主体多写一个例证。
traps: 开头复述题目占太多篇幅
结论重复引言原句

points.title: 观点句与论据展开
points.core: 主题句要可论证（有立场、有限定），论据用「解释 + 例子 + 回扣」三步展开，不要只列观点。
points.detail: 句式：There is no denying that ...；One convincing reason is that ...；A case in point is ...；This is mainly because ...。
traps: 论据与观点不相关
全篇都是 I think 没有支撑

points.title: 衔接与连接词
points.core: 用连接词显性表达逻辑：并列（moreover、in addition）、转折（however、nevertheless）、因果（therefore、as a result）、举例（for instance）、总结（in conclusion）。
points.detail: 同一篇里不要反复用同一个连接词；短句之间可用代词 this/it 回指，避免机械堆砌 firstly/secondly/lastly。
traps: however 后要逗号
on the contrary 用于否定前述，不是简单转折

points.title: 常见题型与模板
points.core: 三类高频题：观点选择（Do you agree?）、现象分析（What are the causes/effects?）、图表/校园生活（描述 + 建议）。每类准备一个骨架即可迁移。
points.detail: 观点类骨架：背景 → 我的立场 → 理由一 + 例 → 理由二 + 例 → 让步 → 结论。现象类骨架：描述现象 → 原因两条 → 影响 → 建议。
traps: 题目问 causes 却只写 opinions
忘记写让步段导致论述单薄

questions.stem: 听力短对话中，听到选项里的原词就选它，通常是最稳妥的做法。
questions.explain: 短对话的正确答案多为同义替换，原词重现往往是干扰项。正确做法是预读选项圈场景词，再听 but/however 后的关键信息。

questions.stem: “I couldn't agree more.” 的意思是「我完全同意」。
questions.explain: couldn't agree more 是「不能再更同意了」，即完全同意。类似的否定 + 比较级结构常表最高级含义。

questions.stem:
听力原文：The train was supposed to leave at 9:15, but it has been delayed by 40 minutes. 
问题：When will the train leave?
questions.explain: 原定 9:15，延迟 40 分钟 → 9:55。9:40 是干扰项（多点算了 25 分钟）。

questions.stem: 听写填空时，三遍录音分别应该做什么？写出你的操作顺序。
questions.answer: ① 第一遍：只听大意，确认空位在句中的位置与前后词，不急着写；② 第二遍：逐空填写，先保证词性正确，拼写不全可用缩写占位；③ 第三遍：核对拼写、单复数、时态、大小写，并检查整句是否通顺。
questions.explain: 评分看「要点是否覆盖」：三遍各有明确任务 + 第三遍的检查项（-s/-ed、大小写）是加分点。

questions.stem:
Passage 1

Many students believe that staying up late is the best way to prepare for exams. They drink coffee, keep the desk lamp on, and memorize as much as possible before dawn. However, research on memory tells a different story. What we learn during the day is consolidated — that is, stabilized and stored — while we sleep. A student who studies for eight hours and sleeps for seven usually remembers more than one who studies for eleven hours and sleeps for four. The reason is simple: without sleep, the brain has no time to file new information away. This does not mean that effort is unimportant. It means that effort without rest is like writing on a whiteboard that is wiped clean every hour.

1. What is the main idea of the passage?
2. According to the passage, what happens to new information during sleep?
3. The author compares effort without rest to ______.
4. What is the author's attitude toward staying up late before exams?
options: A. Sleep is as important as study for memory.
B. Students should never drink coffee.
C. Eleven hours of study is always better.
D. Memory has nothing to do with sleep.
questions.explain: 1. A（主旨：睡眠对记忆同等重要）。2. 它被巩固并储存（consolidated — stabilized and stored）。3. writing on a whiteboard that is wiped clean every hour。4. 否定/不赞同（negative），因为有 however、different story 等转折信号。

questions.stem:
Passage 2

When the first shared-bike companies arrived in Chinese cities, they promised a green solution to the “last mile” problem — the gap between a subway station and one's home. Within two years, however, sidewalks were crowded with broken bikes, and some rivers were full of them. Local governments responded with parking zones and quotas, and companies began to repair rather than replace. The number of bikes in the city center fell by almost half, yet the number of trips did not drop as much. The lesson is not that shared bikes failed, but that a good idea needs rules to survive.

1. What problem were shared bikes designed to solve?
2. What happened within two years?
3. What does “the number of trips did not drop as much” suggest?
4. What is the author's conclusion?
options: A. The last mile between subway and home.
B. Traffic jams in the city center.
C. The price of subway tickets.
questions.explain: 1. A（首段明确 last mile）。2. 人行道堆满坏车、河里也有车。3. 说明减少的是「车辆数量」而不是「使用需求」，管理起作用但需求仍在。4. a good idea needs rules to survive（好点子需要规则才能存活）。

questions.stem: In the sentence “The scheme was hailed as a panacea — a cure for all the city's transport problems.”, the word “panacea” most probably means ______.
options: B. a cure for all problems
questions.explain: 破折号后就是解释：a cure for all the city's transport problems。词义猜测优先看同位语、破折号、举例等上下文线索。

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best title for a passage that discusses causes, effects and possible solutions of food waste on campus?
options: A. A Serious Problem: Food Waste on Campus
C. The History of the Campus Canteen
D. Why Students Like Fast Food
questions.explain: 标题要能覆盖「原因 + 影响 + 对策」三部分。B、C、D 都只覆盖局部或与主题无关。

questions.stem:
选词填空：从下列 9 个词中选 6 个填入空格，每词只用一次。
`adapt  budget  curious  digital  gradually  however  opportunity  reduce  therefore`

Living on a student (1)______ is not easy. Many first-year students spend money quickly in the first month and then find themselves short before the end of the term. (2)______, learning to manage money is an important skill. One simple way is to keep a (3)______ record of every purchase; apps make this easier than before. Another is to (4)______ unnecessary spending by cooking instead of eating out. These habits do not change your life overnight, but they (5)______ make a difference. In fact, the (6)______ to control a small budget today prepares you for larger decisions later.
questions.answer: (1) budget　(2) Therefore　(3) digital　(4) reduce　(5) gradually　(6) opportunity
questions.explain: 先判词性：student 后需名词 → budget；句首 + 逗号 + 因果 → Therefore；修饰 record 需形容词 → digital；to 后需动词原形 → reduce；修饰 make a difference 用副词 → gradually；the ... to control 需名词 → opportunity。

questions.stem: 划分句子主干并说明各成分：The idea that students should learn to manage their time, which is often taken for granted, has been challenged by recent research.
questions.answer:
主干：The idea ... has been challenged by recent research.（主语 The idea，谓语 has been challenged，状语 by recent research）。
① that students should learn to manage their time 是同位语从句，解释 idea 的内容；
② which is often taken for granted 是非限制性定语从句，修饰前面整个「学生应学会管理时间」这一看法；
③ 两个逗号之间的成分先括起来，主干就清楚了。
questions.explain: 答题要点：先给主干，再逐个标从句类型与被修饰对象。把定语从句的谓语当成主句谓语是最常见的错。

questions.stem: The company had to ______ the meeting because the manager was ill.
questions.explain: put off = 推迟；put on 穿上/上演；put up 张贴/搭建；put out 熄灭。句意是「因经理生病不得不推迟会议」。

questions.stem: I'm looking forward to ______ from you soon.
questions.explain: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。同类：be used to doing、devote oneself to doing。

questions.stem: He was chosen to speak ______ of the whole class at the ceremony.
questions.explain: on behalf of = 代表。in charge of 负责；at the expense of 以…为代价；by means of 借助。

questions.stem: By the time we arrived, the film ______ for ten minutes.
questions.explain: for ten minutes 表示持续，begin 是瞬间动词不能与一段时间连用，要用 be on；主句基准是过去，所以用过去完成时 had been on。

questions.stem: When he ______ tomorrow, I will tell him the news.
questions.explain: 时间和条件状语从句用一般现在时表将来（主将从现）。

questions.stem: ______ his homework, he went out to play basketball.
questions.explain: 完成作业在出去打球之前，且逻辑主语是 he（主动），用现在分词的完成式 Having finished。A 是被动，C 表同时，D 表目的。

questions.stem: I still remember ______ this song for the first time in primary school.
questions.explain: remember doing = 记得做过（已发生）；remember to do = 记得去做（未做）。句意是回忆小学时听过。

questions.stem: This is the village ______ we visited last summer.
questions.explain: 从句 visit 缺宾语，所以用关系代词 which（或 that）；若从句不缺成分（we stayed last summer）才用 where。

questions.stem: He failed the exam, ______ made his parents disappointed.
questions.explain: 非限制性定语从句指代前面整句，只能用 which，不能用 that；逗号不能换成句号（否则缺连词）。

questions.stem: If I ______ you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟，if 从句用过去式，be 动词统一用 were；主句用 would + 动词原形。if 从句里不能用 would。

questions.stem: The teacher insisted that the homework ______ handed in on Friday.
questions.explain: insist 表「坚持要求」时从句用 (should) be done，should 可省略，所以是 be handed in。若 insist 表「坚持说」则用陈述语气。

questions.stem: The number of students who take part in the program ______ increasing.
questions.explain: the number of + 复数名词作主语时，中心词是 number，谓语用单数；a number of + 复数名词则用复数。

questions.stem: Not until he got home ______ that he had left his keys in the office.
questions.explain: Not until 置于句首，主句要部分倒装：did + 主语 + 动词原形。

questions.stem: The new policy will ______ the way students choose their courses.
questions.explain: affect 是动词「影响」；effect 多作名词「效果」；effort 名词「努力」；effective 形容词。

questions.stem: She is a very ______ person; she always notices when others are upset.
questions.explain: sensitive = 敏感的、体贴的；sensible = 明智的；sensational = 轰动的；senseless = 无意义的。

questions.stem:
用适当的介词或副词填空：
(1) The accident resulted ______ careless driving.
(2) We should take the cost ______ account before deciding.
(3) He is ______ charge of the project.
questions.explain: result from = 由…引起（result in 是导致）；take ... into account = 把…考虑在内；in charge of = 负责。

questions.stem: 翻译：随着互联网的发展，越来越多的人选择在网上购物。
questions.answer: With the development of the Internet, more and more people choose to shop online.
questions.explain: 踩分点：With the development of（随着…的发展）、more and more（越来越多）、choose to do、shop online。时态用一般现在时。

questions.stem: 翻译：据说这座桥建于明朝，距今已有五百多年历史。
questions.answer: It is said that the bridge was built in the Ming Dynasty and has a history of more than 500 years.
questions.explain: 无主句用 It is said that 形式主语；「建于」用被动 was built；「距今已有」用现在完成 has a history of。

questions.stem: 翻译：学校应该采取措施减少食堂的食物浪费。
questions.answer: The university should take measures to reduce food waste in the canteen.
questions.explain: take measures to do（采取措施做某事）、reduce food waste（减少食物浪费）。主语补 the university 比逐字译 the school 更自然。

questions.stem: 翻译：高质量发展是全面建设社会主义现代化国家的首要任务。
questions.answer: High-quality development is the primary task in building a modern socialist country in all respects.
questions.explain: 固定译法：高质量发展 high-quality development、首要任务 primary task、全面建设社会主义现代化国家 building a modern socialist country in all respects。

questions.stem: 翻译检查清单：交卷前你应该核对哪五项？
questions.answer: ① 时态是否与中文时间一致；② 主谓一致（第三人称单数、单复数）；③ 冠词与可数名词的单复数；④ 拼写与大小写（专有名词、句首）；⑤ 是否漏译或增译导致意思变化。
questions.explain: 整体评分的卷子，语言流畅度靠这五项保证；漏译一句通常比小语法错扣得多。

questions.stem: Writing: Some students prefer to study alone, while others prefer to study in groups. Which do you prefer? Write an essay of 120–150 words to explain your choice.
questions.answer:
参考骨架：
① 引言：Studying is a personal activity, yet the setting matters. Personally, I prefer studying in groups.
② 理由一：Group study fills gaps in understanding — explaining a concept to others exposes what I have not really mastered.
③ 理由二：It keeps me motivated; a fixed schedule with classmates reduces procrastination.
④ 让步：Admittedly, group study can be noisy and inefficient if members are unprepared, so I set a clear agenda for each session.
⑤ 结论：For me, the benefits of shared thinking outweigh the distractions, provided that the group stays on task.
questions.explain: 评分看：三段结构、观点明确、两个理由各带例证、有让步、语言基本正确。开头不要复述题目超过两句。

questions.stem: Writing: More and more college students are addicted to short videos. Write an essay of 120–150 words analyzing the causes and suggesting solutions.
questions.answer:
参考骨架：
① 现象：Short videos have become a common way for students to relax, but many find it hard to stop.
② 原因一：They are designed to be instantly rewarding, which makes them hard to resist.
③ 原因二：Students often lack a clear plan for their free time, so boredom leads to scrolling.
④ 对策：Setting a daily time limit and replacing scrolling with a fixed activity (sports, reading) works better than simply relying on willpower.
⑤ 结论：Short videos are not the enemy; the lack of control is.
questions.explain: 注意题目要求 causes + solutions，只写危害会跑题。对策要具体可执行。

questions.stem: Writing: Write a short essay (120–150 words) on the topic “The Value of Failure”, using at least three different linking words.
questions.answer:
参考骨架：
① Failure is usually treated as something to avoid, yet it is often the most effective teacher.
② 例证：A failed experiment tells a researcher which assumption is wrong — information that success never provides.
③ 递进：Moreover, failure trains persistence; students who revise after a low score improve faster than those who give up.
④ 让步/结论：Of course, failure only helps when we reflect on it. Therefore, what matters is not the setback itself but the review that follows.
questions.explain: 连接词覆盖：yet / Moreover / Of course / Therefore。评分会看衔接是否自然，不要机械堆砌 firstly-secondly。

questions.stem:
下面这段作文开头有什么问题？请改写并说明理由。
“Nowadays, with the development of society, people's living standards are improving. I think we should protect the environment. Environment is very important.”
questions.answer:
问题：① 开头套话（with the development of society）与主题无关，浪费字数；② 三个短句之间没有逻辑连接；③ environment 前缺冠词，句意空泛（very important 没有信息量）。
改写示例：Our city produces twice as much waste as it did ten years ago, yet recycling bins are still hard to find in most neighborhoods. This gap suggests that public awareness alone is not enough.
理由：用具体现象切入，直接指向问题，为后文的观点与对策留出空间。
questions.explain: 改写题的踩分点是「指出问题 + 给出更具体的替代 + 说明为什么更好」。

questions.stem: The new rules will ______ effect next month.
questions.explain: take effect 是固定搭配，表示「生效」。make/bring/put 都不与 effect 这样搭。

questions.stem: He finished the task ______ his own, without any help.
questions.explain: on one's own = 独自地（= by oneself）。注意 by oneself 也对，但选项里没有 oneself 的搭配形式。

questions.stem: She ______ in the library for three hours when I called her.
questions.explain: 「我打电话时她已经学了三个小时」，以过去某一时刻为基准，且强调持续，用过去完成进行时。

questions.stem: The problem ______ at tomorrow's meeting is of great importance.
questions.explain: tomorrow's meeting 表示将来，且 problem 与 discuss 是被动关系，用不定式的被动式 to be discussed 作定语。

questions.stem: This is the reason ______ he refused our offer.
questions.explain: 先行词是 reason，从句 he refused our offer 成分完整，缺的是原因状语，所以用关系副词 why（= for which）。

questions.stem: I wish I ______ more time to prepare for the exam yesterday.
questions.explain: yesterday 表明与过去事实相反，wish 后用过去完成时 had had。若与现在相反用 had。

questions.stem: Neither the teacher nor the students ______ aware of the change.
questions.explain: neither ... nor 连接主语时遵循「就近原则」，谓语与最近的 the students 一致，用 are。

questions.stem: The company decided to ______ the new technology to local conditions.
questions.explain: adapt ... to ... = 使…适应…。adopt 是「采纳」，adept 是形容词「熟练的」，admit 是「承认」。

questions.stem:
Passage 3

For years, universities have measured success by rankings: how many papers, how much funding, how high the position on a list. These numbers are easy to report, but they often reward activities that are visible rather than useful. A teacher who spends an afternoon helping a struggling student produces no data point, yet that afternoon may matter more than a conference paper. Some universities have begun to change this. They ask faculty to describe their teaching in portfolios, and they invite students to explain what actually helped them learn. The change is slow because numbers are convenient. But convenience, as one dean put it, is not the same as truth.

1. What do universities traditionally use to measure success?
2. Why does the author mention the teacher helping a student?
3. What does the dean's remark suggest?
4. What is the author's attitude toward the change?
questions.explain: 1. A（papers, funding, position on a list 都是可量化的排名指标）。2. 用来说明「有价值的事未必产生数据」。3. 数字方便但不等于真相（convenience ≠ truth）。4. 支持但承认推进缓慢（positive yet cautious）。

questions.stem: 选词填空解题步骤：拿到「15 词选 10 空」的题，你按什么顺序做题？
questions.answer: ① 先通读全文抓大意，不看选项；② 给 15 个词标词性（名/动/形/副，注意 -ed/-ing 形式）；③ 逐空判断所需词性：冠词/介词后多为名词，be 动词后多为形容词或过去分词，主语后缺谓语填动词，修饰动词用副词；④ 用搭配与单复数二次筛选；⑤ 剩下的空用排除法，最后通读检查逻辑与语法。
questions.explain: 评分看「词性优先 + 搭配校验 + 排除法」三步是否完整。

questions.stem: 翻译：只有通过不断的练习，才能真正掌握一门外语。
questions.answer: Only through constant practice can one truly master a foreign language.
questions.explain: 「只有…才…」用 Only + 状语置于句首，主句部分倒装（can one master）。这是汉译英里最能体现语法功底的句式。

questions.stem: 翻译：春节是中国最重要的传统节日，家人无论多远都会赶回家团聚。
questions.answer: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China, and family members will return home for a reunion no matter how far away they are.
questions.explain: 踩分点：the Spring Festival（固定译法）、traditional festival、family reunion、no matter how far（让步状语从句）。

questions.stem: 做细节题时，选项中出现原文没有的绝对化词（all、never、only），通常可以优先排除。
questions.explain: 绝对化表述往往与原文的 some/often/may 冲突，是命题人常用的错项手法。但要注意原文本身就有 only 的情况，仍需回原文核对。

questions.stem: 推断题只要推理合理，即使原文没有直接依据也可以选。
questions.explain: 推断题必须「有原文依据、只推一步」。脱离原文的合理联想属于过度推断，是最常见的错项来源。
